reviews.text: A reassuring and caring welcome. Thank you to the SPA for their work.

Hello,
We are sorry to hear of your disappointment. We are doing everything we can to improve our services.

The clinic team

Hello,
Thank you for your kind review! It was a pleasure to be able to help you.

Sincerely,
The Clinic Team

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

This was my first time at this veterinary clinic, and I was pleasantly surprised by the warm welcome. The receptionists were incredibly kind, always smiling and caring.

I would also like to thank all the staff, especially the veterinarian who treated my little cat Mimi for her vaccination. I truly appreciated his professionalism, gentleness, and attentiveness.

A big thank you to the whole team for the warm welcome and your kindness. Keep up the great work! 🐾❤️

A huge thank you to the whole team 🫶💚

My cat Yumi was seen as an emergency after almost three days of calling different vets looking for a solution. You were the only ones who agreed to see him quickly, even though his condition required urgent care.

From the moment we arrived, Yumi was greeted with incredible gentleness: cuddles, little attentions, and even a head massage to reassure him before treatment. 🥹

The vet took the time to put him at ease before doing anything, with genuine kindness.

The whole team was lovely, reassuring, and incredibly compassionate. At a time when I was completely panicked and exhausted, you truly made a difference.

Thank you so much for taking such gentle care of my baby. I will never forget your kindness. 💚🫶
I would like to thank the team at the animal shelter who were responsive and attentive and who were able to treat my cat who had an ovarian infection.
Thank you so much! Truly, a thousand thanks for your support. I will be eternally grateful in March and July. My bulldog is my whole life. Best of luck to you!

Hello,

Thank you for this positive feedback!

With our warmest regards,
The Paris Dispensary Team

I've been going there for a year now because I can't afford it and my cat is extremely sick. I want to thank the reception staff from the bottom of my heart. They always greet me with a smile and such kindness. They always respond very quickly and do everything they can to help me organize my cat's care. And a huge thank you to Dr. Moukhtar-Fouad, who always treats my little baby Shanks, who sees me whenever he can, and who remains so kind and optimistic for my cat. I don't know how to thank you all enough. If you only knew how much my cat means to me, and I'm so glad to leave him in the care of people who love animals and take such good care of them. Thank you for everything ❤️

In a difficult financial situation, I had my cat Naki neutered at the animal shelter on Rue Mallarmé.

I was very anxious, but the staff were attentive and very pleasant. My cat and I had a lovely time.

I look forward to having enough income to financially support the shelter.

It was a wonderful experience. Thank you for your work, see you soon.

I want to express my immense gratitude to the doctors and all the staff at the clinic!

We were seen as an emergency patient, without an appointment, and completely free of charge. Everything was explained to us clearly and in detail, with great care, kindness, and professionalism.

A huge thank you for your kindness, responsiveness, and love for animals! I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic to all pet owners. We are happy, and our beloved pets are too! 🐾

Absolutely fantastic. The staff is exceptional. So friendly.

I was worried about my little cat, and they reassured me completely.
I'm so happy to entrust them with my cat's health. Thank you! ❤️
Thank you for the staff's dedication and kindness, thank you, thank you!

Hello Naziha,

Thank you so much for your rating! We are very touched by your satisfaction.

Sincerely,
The Paris SPA Dispensary Team

Not one, not two, but three little female cats, all spayed on the same morning, spend year after year rolling on the ground, purring with their tails curled, with the males at their heels.

I'm obviously not suggesting they only had their tubes tied (although, all three at the same time…), which would be utterly heretical for the SPCA, but if they did indeed have spays, please slow down or get your eyes checked to ensure no ovarian tissue is left.
Since the uterus is still present, there's a risk of pregnancy and contracting FIV/FeLV, and if these were cats meant to be released, it would be catastrophic and counterproductive!
And since I have a cat with a heart condition who can't be neutered, I suffer all the inconveniences, plus the possibility of pregnancy, with the cats howling, him mounting them, and getting out of breath! Appalling!!!!

Hello,
Thank you so much for this lovely review! We're delighted we were able to help.

Best regards,
The clinic team
No toilet despite the long wait, forced to keep going back and forth

My little cat, who had been spayed, died two days later. We are devastated. The only explanation is bad luck; it's rare. She was in perfect health before the operation. The cone was very tight. I took her back, she was put on oxygen, and 30 minutes later they told me she had died. I'm traumatized for life by spaying without a pre-operative consultation. The guilt of having had her spayed will forever be etched in my heart...
A wonderful welcome, great atmosphere, and excellent care. Bravo and thank you to the whole team for our little ones! See you soon with our angel Pilou...😺 …

My son and I came because our cat was very sick, and today she's better.

I really wanted to thank the vet and his assistant for the warm welcome and care they provided.
Thank you for our animals.
Thank you for trying to save my little dog and for being there for me during these difficult times.

Thank you so much! Thanks to Dr. Fouad Nabil, my rabbit is saved! Cookie had a serious intestinal blockage, but the doctor and his team never gave up!
They truly have big hearts!
Thank you a thousand times!
Warm welcome and precise care

Don't forget your tax exemption certificate!
The rates are lower. That's fine. The process was a bit rushed, but that's understandable... the cause is worthy. The wait is tolerable. Thank you.

They didn't help. The cat has wounds all over his body, like an allergic reaction, hair loss, oozing skin, and a huge ulcer on his neck. They said it was fleas and sent him to a clinic where they would admit him without paperwork. The cat has a European passport, no fleas in sight, and the last flea treatment was two weeks and a week ago, and everything is clean.
Don't come here—they won't help our kind.

Hello,
Thank you for taking the time to rate us. We are doing our best to provide an even more attentive service.

The clinic team
These are the best vets with such big hearts! They saved my little cat who was about to die! I wish the whole team all the best, a huge thank you to you all. 💘 Good luck to you, you're amazing! …

I can't thank the entire staff of the clinic enough. I submitted an emergency case for my cat, who was very ill, and I got an appointment in less than a week, even though the clinic was extremely busy.

My cat's condition worsened significantly on Friday, two hours before closing time. Suspecting they were full, I emailed them, and they were there to advise and guide me. Following their advice, I went to another veterinarian for emergency treatment, and it saved my cat.

When the appointment arrived, the reception and care were perfect. My cat was treated under anesthesia (abscess...) and had several tests done for a health check-up, including a scheduled follow-up visit. When I picked him up, the veterinarian gave excellent advice and answered all my questions.

If you have your pet treated there, please consider making a donation. Even €10, €20, whatever you can afford. Having your pet treated in such excellent conditions, and with a voluntary contribution, is a true privilege. This must continue.

I could never have afforded this care at a regular veterinary clinic without putting myself in serious financial difficulty. And even if something happens to my cats, I have the peace of mind knowing that, in the worst-case scenario, the clinic will be there for me. Thank you so much.
PROFESSIONAL, FRIENDLY, CLEAN... WITH YEARS OF EXPERIENCE!

Hello,
Thank you so much for this lovely review! We're delighted we were able to help.

Best regards,
The clinic team

Very bad experience – loss of my cat due to inappropriate care

I have been registered with the SPA Paris 17 clinic for years and trusted them. This time, my cat Milou (6 years old, previously healthy) died within a week following what I consider to be inappropriate care.

Summary of events:
• For a simple cough (bronchitis), the clinic gave him an injection followed by a prescription for strong antibiotics (8 days) and a dewormer; Milou is an indoor cat with no prior health issues.

• As soon as he started the treatment, he began vomiting, refused to eat, and his condition gradually deteriorated. I alerted the clinic by email and phone but received no prompt response.

• After an ultrasound (which showed liver damage), the clinic still administered further antibiotic injections even though they knew his liver was affected. No immediate treatment with intravenous fluids was provided. • I was only directed to start an IV drip the following day; the process was slow and sometimes rushed. One of the veterinarians was very curt, lacking in empathy, and even mentioned euthanasia without clear explanations, when all I asked was that he be given every chance. He was given back to me after a few hours of IV fluids, with the explanation that there was no point in coming back the next day because of a transport strike.

• I had to consult another veterinarian (at my own expense) who told me that Milou's condition was consistent with acute hepatitis, probably aggravated by the medication, fasting, and dehydration, and that earlier intervention (IV fluids, stopping the toxic medications) could have helped. Unfortunately, Milou died shortly afterward.

Important: I contributed financially: €50 + €20 and paid for an ultrasound (approximately €100). This is not a "free" clinic, in fact. I contributed and would have been willing to help further if the need for faster hospitalization had been clearly explained to me. Instead, I believe that care was delayed and treatments administered that may have worsened his condition.

I want to thank the nurse, who was kind and dedicated. However, the veterinarians on duty that day lacked empathy and explanations, and their management seemed inappropriate to me. I am posting this review to warn other owners: be vigilant, always ask for reports, demand copies of examinations, and don't hesitate to seek a second opinion. PS: After reading the negative comments, I also want to clarify that it is Dr. Fouad, and yes, he should be reported to the Veterinary Medical Association because several of us have had the same experience. As a believer, I believe in divine justice; he will be held accountable for his actions towards animals and us humans who truly love our animals!
My dog ​​had surgery on 8/9/2025, I was still waiting and went to the church garden. The whole team is very nice, clean and competent,,🙏🙏👍👍 …

Thank you so much for your warm welcome, your professionalism, and your kindness; it's become very rare.

Thank you to Dr. Sava Paula-Maria, who was able to diagnose my dog's health problems. (My usual vet couldn't, which I find very serious.)
So, thank you very much for what you do.
I encourage those who come to your clinic to contribute and donate what they can so that this service can continue to help us and our animals. A big thank you!

Appointment booked for a female cat.
The staff (receptionists) and the veterinarian were very welcoming and gave my cat an excellent check-up:
Feeling her heart, inspecting and cleaning her nasal passages, ears, abdomen, teeth, and checking her weight.
The veterinarian was very professional, answered all my questions, and even wrote down what my cat needed if I wished, and prescribed vaccinations according to my cat's needs.
A huge thank you to these women who know how to care for animals at unbeatable prices, and to all animal clinics.

I recommend this clinic 100%. Appointments are booked exclusively by email, but you are usually given an appointment date no more than a month from the date you sent your email.

I went to this clinic twice in one week.

One of my cats got sick, and the other needed to be examined.

Dr. Fouad and his assistant, Cécile, were a great help. They were very patient with my cats (who aren't very calm), and they were very patient when I tried to explain things and ask questions (it's not my native language; I'm just learning French).
At the end of the second visit, they gave me advice about both cats and even gave me something that might help my sick cat.
I am very grateful to Dr. Fouad and Cécile for their help, as well as to the clinic for its friendly and competent staff, and for the pleasant, clean, and quiet environment. 🤍 I highly recommend this clinic for a visit with your four-legged companions. :)
Friendly clinic. Competent doctor. A helpful facility for people in need.
Always so serious and professional

They have been racist from the first minute. Now they haven't even responded to three of my letters in eight days, and my dog ​​has cancer. I wrote to them not to look stupid, they blocked me. They say it's free, but you have to pay every time. Is that good? Is that nice?
Thank you for the always excellent and warm welcome. And a very friendly vet with great advice. Thank you all for your work. Our little cat thanks you too!
I'm not friends with the staff at the clinic, but I want to say that they are very competent and professional. Unfortunately, they are very often extremely busy.

Hello,

I disagree with the negative reviews.

A very warm welcome, appointments made by email, they are responsive.

We had a consultation appointment, followed by teeth cleaning, treatment for our dog's eye and anal gland.

The staff are pleasant and efficient, a top-notch veterinarian.

So yes, of course, it's normal to need documentation to access these services and proof of our financial situation; it's common sense…

People who can afford it should go to a veterinarian, and if not, the clinic is there, but you need to at least provide proof of your situation with a simple tax return—nothing complicated.

As for the animal, it must be spayed or neutered, but that's understandable given the number of animals sold by individuals and the number of abandonments; it's a perfectly legitimate requirement. If the person doesn't agree, they are under no obligation to go to the SPCA.

Adopting an animal is a responsibility and a commitment; you must be able to live up to it. The SPA (Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals) does its best with its resources and staff to meet the needs. However, funds are not unlimited, nor are expenses… so yes, there are conditions. It is not a business or a for-profit enterprise.

A big thank you to the SPA and its teams. Thank you for taking care of our animals and helping us every day with their health.

A huge thank you to Corinne for her kindness and hospitality, I will come back to make donations as soon as I have the opportunity because I would be infinitely grateful for the care given to my mother's cats.
Alright
Excellent service and very professional; money isn't everything to them.

Hello, another visit to the SPA Paris 17th arrondissement clinic. Always so efficient, and the entire team remains dedicated and friendly. As for Corinne, she remains radiant with her frankness and reassuring cheerfulness. Big shout-out to Estelle and the veterinarian. I highly recommend it! 😇 Consider making a donation! …
Last week, twice in a row, I went to the store with my cat 🐈🐱 to get information about neutering him. I received no useful answers, and I'm disappointed. They say the animals are abandoned. 🤩 …
Very warm welcome

I do not recommend this animal shelter. They will offer no help if your dog (even a puppy) is refused. They are simply scammers. It doesn't surprise me at all in Paris; it's not a good place for dogs who never see the light of day. This city was chosen for its finances and donations (which go into their pockets), not for animal welfare. Go elsewhere to a real shelter where all dogs will be accepted. I give it -5 stars 🌟

I thought you were there for animal welfare and to help people in difficulty. I contacted you yesterday, and you asked me to send you documents concerning my current situation, which is very, very critical. I explained that my cat had an eye problem and that it was absolutely essential that you see him. You are inhumane, and in truth, you don't love animals. You're leaving an animal in distress simply because I absolutely must provide you with my entire tax return. I can provide it, but last year my situation was fine, but today I'm in a situation where I no longer receive any income and I can't get my cat medical care. I even offered to volunteer until my situation improves, and you send me this email knowing my situation and all the letters I've sent you that prove how critical it is. All your TV appearances are just for show; in reality, you don't help anyone.
Great service, fast and proactive. I love this association
When I contacted them urgently, they were very responsive and helpful. Thank you to the whole team. I couldn't post sooner because the review window wouldn't open in my browser. Regards
Terrible secretary
Excellent vet and lovely staff if you don't abuse their services, as it's an association that relies on donations.

If your pet isn't neutered, they refuse to treat it. Frankly, it's ridiculous! Neutered, it can be treated; unneutered, it remains sick. Given that this is an emergency and I can't currently afford to go to a vet because of the prices they charge, what's the point of your clinic??? You could easily neuter it and ask for a contribution, which is normal, but refusing to treat it when it's an animal in distress is outrageous! And you call yourselves animal protection? Great! 👍🏼
The staff were very friendly.
No service! But they gave me a good idea 👍🏻 …

The welcome at the Paris SPA is fantastic, with helpful advice, smiles, and genuine kindness. Thank you to Lou and her colleagues for answering all our questions, providing lots of helpful tips and advice, and see you very soon...
It's been impossible to reach them for 4 days.

I recommend them 100%! I came in for an emergency they couldn't normally handle, and they clearly saved my dog! I can't thank them enough for what they did in that emergency. It proves they care about the love of animals, not the profit they might be making!
The vets and assistants are fantastic and explain very clearly what they're doing and what will need to be done next.
It's just a shame that no one answers the phone if you have a question…
A very caring animal shelter, thank you again for your kindness ;). The staff are excellent and competent.
A warm welcome even though it was crowded. Corinne was as efficient as ever, as was the rest of the team! I recommend it (for those who are eligible; see website).
Hello. What is Lure's email address for making an appointment? Please!
Absolutely useless, avoid it
Thank you for the dog! 🙏😘 …
